key_insight: Batching parameter-shift evaluations into each quantum job accelerates quantum neural network training under matched job and shot budgets.
engineering_relevance: Optimizer design should maximize useful progress per cloud submission, not just per shot, to amortize quantum-processor access overhead.
method: Compare optimizers using equal job counts and shots per job.
Preassemble parameter-shift batches to estimate gradients in one submission.
Test a structure-aware stencil search that interprets evaluations as sinusoids.
evidence_signal: For 24–48 parameters, simulated parameter-shift training needed 20–50% as many jobs as SPSA; across three interleaved IBM hardware runs at six and eight qubits, it matched SPSA’s final training loss in 4–20 versus 50 jobs.
watch_item: Hardware evidence is limited to six- and eight-qubit models, and the test-accuracy advantage was not significant at six qubits.
paper_title: Training quantum neural networks one job at a time
